verdict.rationale: Unleash is a feature-flag management platform, not an agent or AI assistant; the evidence only shows Unleash exposing its own functionality via an MCP server for external coding assistants to use (docs-7, probe-2), which is the reverse relationship (Unleash as server, not as client consuming other MCP tools). There is no notion of Unleash itself plugging in external MCP servers to gain new tool capabilities, so this client-side MCP axis is a category mismatch for this product type.
